title: Changes to employee share schemes, including Company Share Option Plan and Enterprise Management Incentives
text:
This measure makes changes to the Company Share Option Plan ( CSOP ) and Enterprise Management Incentives ( EMI ), which are tax-advantaged employee share schemes. It also changes certain non-tax-advantaged share options.

 The measure will:

 • increase the individual option limit for CSOP 

 • remove the interaction between the CSOP and EMI option limits

 • increase the maximum exercise period for CSOP options

 • increase the period that certain tax-advantaged and non-tax-advantaged shares and share options are excepted from the disguised remuneration rules

 • extend the Employee Ownership Trusts exception in the EMI rules

 • increase the EMI exercise window following disqualifying events

 The changes will take effect from 6 April 2027.
